name: Cozy-NHW v8 false-positive causal gating audit
limitations: Event catalog classification and synthetic server policies are NOT proof that each native sensor is free of false positives.
Native source modifications to ThreadSpawn and NoAccess have NOT been compiled on Delphi RAD Studio 13 Win64.
Other 202 original native sensor implementations remain unchanged; changes are only to the central V5 server policy for those kinds.
V1-V4 remain under prior policy and historical recorded decisions are not rewritten.
Required code-integrity and module measurement failures continue to deny execution separately from NHW detection labels.
A server draft candidate must be tested before production rollout.
